Stand tall with the feet under the hips: Pair hips ke neeche rakhkar aur arms jaise running ke liye bent rakhkar seedhe khade ho jaao.
Stand tall with your arms reaching forwa: Arms aage shoulder height pe pahuchakar aur elbows mein halka bend rakhkar seedhe khade ho jaao.
Stand tall with your arms relaxed at you: Arms sides mein relaxed aur knees mein halka bend rakhkar seedhe khade ho jaao.
Stand tall with your chest up, your chin: Chest up, chin level aur knees soft rakhkar seedhe khade ho jaao.
Stand tall with your feet about hip-widt: Pair lagbhag hip-width ke alag aur arms sides mein relaxed rakhkar seedhe khade ho jaao.
